result.detail: Deviation to record: microarchitecture section 5 plans SymbiYosys proofs (apb_gpio.sby and apb_gpio_n32.sby). This task's expected outputs are rtl_source and testbench, and formal.run accepts exactly one .sby, so I submitted no formal_spec. That leaves the planned proof as a follow-up item for the tech lead to schedule. The design-intent assertions in apb_gpio.v sit under `ifdef FORMAL` and are unexercised until a proof is set up. The platform lints and synthesizes with the default parameters (N = 8); the spec also asks for lint at N = 32. The testbench instantiates N = 32, so that width is at least elaborated in simulation. Under Verilator's default error limit, the first $error may end the run before the verdict line prints; it fails either way. The testbench uses #1 delays, so it needs Verilator timing support (--binary or --timing).
